description: This file defines the public API for MDIO (Management Data Input/Output) drivers in the Zephyr project, including function prototypes, data structures, and macros for interacting with MDIO hardware.

methods.name: mdio_bus_enable
methods.description: Enables the MDIO bus for a given device.

methods.name: mdio_bus_disable
methods.description: Disables the MDIO bus and tri-states drivers for a device.

methods.name: mdio_read
methods.description: Performs a read operation on the MDIO bus for a specified port and register.

methods.name: mdio_write
methods.description: Performs a write operation on the MDIO bus for a specified port and register.

methods.name: mdio_read_c45
methods.description: Performs a Clause 45 MDIO read operation.

methods.name: mdio_write_c45
methods.description: Performs a Clause 45 MDIO write operation.
